BatchExecuteStatement.description_en: Calls the BatchExecuteStatement operation to execute batch SQL statements on a set of data
BatchExecuteStatement.description_zh: 调用BatchExecuteStatement接口对一组数据执行批处理SQL语句

CommitTransaction.description_en: Commits transaction changes by calling the CommitTransaction operation
CommitTransaction.description_zh: 调用CommitTransaction接口提交事务变更

ExecuteStatement.description_en: Executes an SQL statement on a specified database by calling the ExecuteStatement operation
ExecuteStatement.description_zh: 调用ExecuteStatement接口对指定数据库执行SQL语句

InsertList.description_en: Invokes InsertList to bulk insert data

RollbackTransaction.description_en: Rolls back a transaction by calling the RollbackTransaction operation. Rolling back a transaction cancels its changes
RollbackTransaction.description_zh: 调用RollbackTransaction接口执行事务的回滚，回滚事务会取消其更改
